verdict.rationale: Financial-account products could plausibly offer user-configured background automations such as scheduled transfers or sweep rules, so this axis applies. The evidence shows none. Stripe's built-in automatic risk controls and the auto-updating disclosure component are Stripe-run features, not automations the user sets up. Transaction events and APIs are only developer building blocks for constructing automation externally.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
